events.text: Fourteen map icons on this hill, and not one of them is yellow.
Is that a waterfall? It's GORGEOUS.
Is that... a bit of yellow? Okay...
I guess that counts as yellow.
Going to do the yellow thing.
Is that a ledge? It's not yellow, so no.
A waystone! I can see the waystone!
The ceiling has frescoes. Someone painted a ceiling.
Is that a tower I can climb to reveal the map? No? Just a tower.
I've never made a jump in my life. Here goes!
Going to do the yellow thing.
Made it! Can I go back and look at the scenery?

profile.intro: Streams everything. Chat demands every collectible on screen. Jumping is another story.
